name: How do I choose between warm white and cool white under cabinet lighting?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between warm white and cool white under cabinet lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice between warm white and cool white lighting depends on the desired ambiance and the existing decor of your space. Warm white light (typically 2700K-3000K) emits a soft, yellowish glow, similar to incandescent bulbs, creating a cozy and inviting atmosphere. Cool white light (typically 4000K-5000K) has a bluer, brighter appearance, providing a more modern and energetic feel, often preferred for task-oriented areas. Consider your kitchen's paint colors, countertop materials, and overall style when making your selection. Dimmable options allow for flexibility.
acceptedAnswer.description: Warm white creates a cozy feel, while cool white offers a modern, brighter look. Choose based on desired ambiance and existing decor.
